# Velantrim Exo-Cortex Crystal

> Local-first, stdlib-only, verifiable AI memory infrastructure. Crystal stores
> source-grounded facts in a canonical graph, admits new knowledge only through a
> TruthGate, and emits replayable traces/receipts so answers can be audited.
> This is the public, grant-facing open core (reviewer-preview) — not Titan,
> Full Exo-Cortex, or Research Mode.

Version: v0.3.0 (reviewer-preview). License: AGPL-3.0.

Core formula: Graph/Canon = Truth | Index/Retrieval = Find | TruthGate = Admission |
Trace/Receipt = Proof | LLM = Speech | Human = Final Judgment.

Quality: 100% line-coverage enforced as a CI gate on Python 3.11 / 3.12; security
checks include bandit and pip-audit. For current pass/skip counts and the
reproducible baseline, see TEST_REPORT.md and the latest CI run (counts are not
duplicated here to avoid drift).
